نشتعل (form VIII)
# نَشْتَعِلُ (naštaʕilu) /naʃ.ta.ʕi.lu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِشْتَعَلَ (ištaʕala)
# نُشْتَعَلُ (nuštaʕalu) /nuʃ.ta.ʕa.lu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِشْتَعَلَ (ištaʕala)
# نَشْتَعِلَ (naštaʕila) /naʃ.ta.ʕi.la/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِشْتَعَلَ (ištaʕala)
# نُشْتَعَلَ (nuštaʕala) /nuʃ.ta.ʕa.la/:
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
